description: Adds a check for reaching Level 30 in a run with each character.
Adds a check for each optional boss: the Suspicious Bush (Forest), the Bandit (Desert) and Spooky Steve (Graveyard).
Adds a check for each of the Forest and Desert challenges (22 checks).
Adds the Graveyard map: the Graveyard Access item and its checks.
Adds 15 checks for minibosses defeated in total over all your runs, up to 50. Minibosses called up at boss statues count.
Adds 12 traps to the item pool: a miniboss, a swarm, a pack of elites, poison, slowness or a freeze arrives in your run when the item does. They need the mod; without it they do nothing.
